name: Metric anchoring
detail: Report references gain/loss on cost, pooled vehicle exposure, and concentration.

name: Section completeness
detail: Performance, methodology, allocation, attribution, evidence synthesis, risk, implications, outlook, appendices, and references are present.

name: Vague language control
detail: Conditional language is allowed only when tied to a metric, cited evidence, or portfolio exposure.

name: Identifier coverage
detail: All demo holdings include at least one ISIN, SEDOL, or ticker identifier.

name: Public-source boundary
detail: The public website is static. Live source fetching runs only in the local Python app.
